original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

first_step.inspect: Locate the selected packing source in the review and check live PRs for the same residual problem.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Define an unclaimed canonical domain and a favorable bound before starting a new search.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

actual_scope: For the pending R438 bit supplier of PR1043 (helper 470 deleted): is there an improving local transport on its word, and what is the optimal stage-window-respecting re-hosting of its freed width-8 slack under the PR1023 slot model, with exact endpoints?
scope_change_reason: The selected bit packing (PR589/R439) is already proved slot-optimal by PR1023 and transport-locally optimal by PR1345; the genuinely unsearched bounded improvement is on the pending R438 word, whose README states no hosting search was run and whose word was never run through the transport atlas (which crashed on it).
bottleneck_link: Side result on the non-binding bit supplier: bit headroom only (+0.0819% over PR589), no kappa change while the complex supplier binds. It also repairs the PR1345 atlas, whose improving branch had never been exercised.
stop_rule: Stop after the transported word passes PR1043 replay and xcheck_p with frameopt/atlas local optimality, the re-hosting optimum is proved by exact DP plus enumeration with window feasibility and an audited placement, and both endpoints are certified; no deletion or triple search in this session.
evidence: verify_transport.py: R438 rebuild matches PR1043 certificate; transported word (gzip sha256 a353999b...) passes PR1043 replay and xcheck_p H1-H5 on 660 columns; frameopt 0, atlas 0 singles/0 pairs; c=0.001734220472884893243548. verify_rehost.py: unique S=54 optimum 10x(42,5)+1x(42,4), 22/22 window splits feasible, audited placement, c=0.001734802047828389852783 and 0.001734846264120199151475, 29 controls. atlas_bugs.py: two crashes reproduced and fixed; PR589 result.json reproduced by patched atlas.
